delta.description: the 1975 period-three statement and the homotopy continuation programme are an impossibility statement and a constructive workaround for the same act of forgetting a path. Read from the published pages, the hypothesis is the inequality d <= a < b < c with b = F(a), c = F^2(a), d = F^3(a); period three satisfies it and is not it, and the uncountable-set conclusion carries two clauses, so distinct provenances stay distinct while their values become indistinguishable infinitely often. That is the theorem form of the rule this programme already runs on. AEG's hierarchy, homotopy continuation and this programme's identity discipline all refuse the last arrow, the endpoint value.

origin_hypothesis.printed_form: d <= a < b < c (or d >= a > b > c), b = F(a), c = F^2(a), d = F^3(a)
origin_hypothesis.common_misquote: a point of period three, which is a corollary and not the hypothesis
four_corrections: the hypothesis is the inequality, not a period-three point
sensitivity is never claimed; chaotic appears in quotation marks only
the phrase scrambled set does not occur in the 1975 paper
the 1975 paper does not cite Sharkovsky

two_clause_conclusion.clause_one: lim sup of the distance is positive, so the pair never merges
two_clause_conclusion.clause_two: lim inf of the distance is zero, so the pair becomes indistinguishable infinitely often
two_clause_conclusion.reading: value-level agreement recovers no provenance, as a theorem rather than a discipline

three_refusals_of_the_last_arrow: AEG hierarchy: expression tree, marked history, operator, geometric or quotient state, endpoint value; each arrow forgets information
homotopy continuation: a solution is a tracked path, and a loop around the discriminant locus permutes the solutions
this programme: identity is carried by source, occurrence and history, never by value

shared_exact_matrix.relation: equal characteristic polynomial t^2 - t - 1, and conjugate by a swap of the two basis vectors
shared_exact_matrix.note: derived from exact interval images, not stipulated

two_controls_refusing_the_dynamical_read.tame_side: the golden one-hole map on [1,2] is monotone, with one attracting fixed point and no two-cycle, so the shared polynomial governs a tame map too
two_controls_refusing_the_dynamical_read.rotation_side: the rotation by one third has every point of period three and is an exact isometry, so three alone is not chaos outside an interval

documented_holes: no AEG object, adva object or three-computer cycle is shown to be an interval map, to carry an order structure, or to have a periodic orbit of any period
the three cyclic readings of one carrier are compatible with the rotation control and nothing here distinguishes them from it
the identification of Human, World and Machine with the temporal, spatial and constructive computers remains Open and is not advanced
the folding that separates the tame regime from the chaotic one is not characterized; only its existence is exhibited by two examples
the uncountable set, the sharpness of the Sharkovsky ordering and the least-entropy role of the golden ratio are imported, not reproved
no source links the chaos programme and the homotopy programme as an intention; the link is an outside reading recorded as one
the continuation contract argued for in the reading plan is not opened by this round
no_claims: no new native semantics, no new epoch, no library word and no Seal
no promotion of the analogy to a claim about this programme
no claim that period three implies chaos for any threefold structure of this programme
no claim that the shared characteristic polynomial identifies two spaces, two semantics or one dynamics
